name: DingTalk Workspace
description: Use DingTalk as the current authorized user to manage to-dos, messages, Drive files, and documents.
installationSteps: Enable the plugin, then choose Install DWS to install the CLI on the Bot Computer.
Choose Authenticate DingTalk and complete the browser sign-in and permission authorization. Your organization must enable CLI access first.
Wait for Connected. The page shows the DWS version and account verified on the Bot Computer; the page checks the latest stable CLI online and shows Upgrade DWS only when a newer version is available.
Choose a usage tip to close this page and fill the main Bot chat with an editable prompt. The prompt is not sent automatically.
The login belongs to the Bot Computer. Other Bots on the same Computer share it; uninstalling the plugin does not remove DWS or its credentials.

skills.name: dingtalk-setup
skills.description: Install the pinned DingTalk Workspace CLI, manage the selected Computer's login state, import or export a one-time portable auth bundle, and diagnose connection failures.

skills.name: dingtalk-workspace
skills.description: Use the current authorized DingTalk user to query and handle to-dos, messages, personal IM events, Drive files, and DingTalk documents.

usageTips.title: Review pending to-dos
usageTips.prompt: List all my unfinished DingTalk to-dos with a brief description of each item, including overdue status, due dates, roles, task IDs, and whether data.complete confirms that all pages were fetched. Do not modify anything.

usageTips.title: Plan today’s work
usageTips.prompt: Review my DingTalk to-dos due today and overdue tasks. Suggest a prioritized work plan without changing the tasks.

usageTips.title: Handle an approval
usageTips.prompt: Find my pending DingTalk approval applications and summarize the applicant, dates, purpose, and current approval status. Let me choose which application to process.

usageTips.title: Find project documents
usageTips.prompt: Search my authorized DingTalk documents and Drive files for [project keyword]. Summarize relevant documents with their original links.

usageTips.title: Update a document section
usageTips.prompt: Read this authorized DingTalk document: [document link]. Update [section] with [new content], preserve other content, and read back the changed section to verify it.

usageTips.title: Turn a document into tasks
usageTips.prompt: Read [DingTalk document link] and draft action items with owners and due dates. Show me the proposed to-dos before creating them.

usageTips.title: Export a document
usageTips.prompt: Export [DingTalk document link] to DOCX and provide the resulting file. Keep the original document unchanged.

usageTips.title: Prepare a weekly summary
usageTips.prompt: Use my DingTalk to-dos from [date range] and these authorized documents: [document links] to draft a weekly summary of completed work, blockers, and next steps. Show the draft before saving or sending it.
